one_liner: Watches a live on-chain lending pool's health score and fires a single alert on a real threshold transition — never twice.
what_it_does: This lamp watches a lending pool's health score — a number that says how close a loan is to liquidation — and raises one alert when it crosses into the danger zone. It alerted exactly once on a real crossing, and later re-checks correctly said nothing new. Proven by 5 real transactions plus 1 real delivered alert on the Atlantic testnet, all linked below.
